prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_stage_layout: Redesign the choose_path screen into a stage layout featuring animated mascot highlights to help users quickly pick their onboarding path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Choose your companion journey!"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] home_intro_pet_interaction_tutorial: Add a new pet interaction tutorial screen during home_intro to demonstrate desktop pet movement and key controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls", "home_intro"], "components": [{"type": "text", "style": "emphasis", "text": "Learn basic pet controls"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_personality_quiz: Introduce a pet personality preference questionnaire on pick_friend using choice cards to help users select their ideal companion.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "text": "What type of companion fits your work style?"}]}}
3: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_spotlight_reassurance: Redesign sign_in screen to a spotlight layout focusing on cloud sync assurances to guarantee pets are saved.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Sync your account to save your pet", "body": "Signing in ensures your pet and desktop progress are safely backed up across devices."}}
4: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_diagnostic_checklist: Add a diagnostic checklist component on the waiting screen showing desktop rendering readiness checks.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "subtle", "text": "Verifying desktop rendering capabilities..."}]}}
5: [finish, layout] home_intro_checklist_layout: Switch home_intro to a checklist layout showing key onboarding completion tasks.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "body": "Complete these quick steps to start interacting with your new friend on your desktop."}}
6: [choose_path, hint] story_quick_start_hint: Add a quick-start helper text hint on the story screen encouraging fast progression.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Select any path to get started immediately—you can customize your pet anytime!"}}
7: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_cloud_save_badge: Display an explicit 'Cloud Save Protected' badge on the sign_in screen.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "text": "Cloud Save Protected"}]}}
8: [adoption, copy] adoption_certificate_fallback_notice: Update adoption certificate copy to reassure users that default pet assets will apply if photo generation fails.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Adoption Confirmed!", "body": "Your pet is being crafted. If custom styling encounters issues, default styles will safely apply."}}
9: [home, notification] waiting_sound_notification: Enable notify_when_ready and add a pleasant audio chime when pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "style": "calm", "text": "Play notification sound when pet lands on desktop"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning choose_path screen layout while preserving core options is allowed.
Adding a new pet controls tutorial screen within onboarding flows is permitted.
Adding a personality quiz to assist pet selection on pick_friend preserves core functionality.
Redesigning the sign_in screen layout with sync assurances is permitted inside onboarding.
Adding diagnostic checklist information to the waiting screen is permitted.
Changing the layout of home_intro to a checklist layout is allowed within onboarding.
Adding helper hint text on the story screen is permitted.
Adding a reassurance badge on the sign_in screen is allowed.
Updating adoption certificate copy with reassurance text retains core screen functionality.
Enabling ready notifications and audio chimes on the waiting screen is allowed.
